# HigherMindAI

> Local ranking and AI intake systems for property and community association management firms across the United States and Canada, with law firms as a second book. I rank a firm so owners searching for a manager find it, put a desk on the other end that answers and qualifies every enquiry, and hand over a timestamped record of every contact. Operated by one person. Based in Erin, Ontario. Live in 14 to 21 days.

## Property & condominium management - the specialty
- [Property Management](https://highermindai.com/property-management): the track hub. Four engines - The Inflow (ranking and paid demand), The Desk (intake), The Record, The Watermark (reputation) - and the arithmetic on a single door.
- [The Keystone](https://highermindai.com/the-keystone): the full system. All four engines welded together, plus the configurator and published rates.
- [The Well](https://highermindai.com/property-management-seo): the organic half of The Inflow. Google Business Profile rebuilt and held in the local pack for the terms owners actually type. The Tap is the paid half.
- [The Desk](https://highermindai.com/property-management-intake): one intake desk on two channels, the web and the phone, with the scope limits published in full. Either channel alone or both; adding the second later costs what it would have cost on day one.
- [The Record](https://highermindai.com/property-management/the-record): every contact logged with the time it came in and the time it was answered, plus a monthly report written to be tabled at a board meeting unedited.
- [Condominium Management Marketing](https://highermindai.com/condominium-management-marketing): the board track. Reputation and record first, ranking third and defensive.
- [Cities](https://highermindai.com/property-management-seo/locations/): per-city ranking pages across the Headwaters, the GTA, Southwestern Ontario and Greater Moncton.

## Law firms - the second book
- [The Watershed](https://highermindai.com/the-watershed): the legal flagship. Intake first, because a person in a crisis retains whoever picks up.
- [AI Intake Desk](https://highermindai.com/law-firm-intake): 24/7 answering, screening and booking on phone and web.
- [Ranking & Lead Generation](https://highermindai.com/law-firm-seo): Google Business Profile into the local pack top three, plus paid campaigns.

## Shared
- [AI Search Optimization / GEO](https://highermindai.com/ai-search-optimization): getting named by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews.
- [Who I Help](https://highermindai.com/solutions): property and condominium management is the specialty, law firms second; also accountants, clinics, veterinary, insurance brokers and other appointment-led businesses.
- [About](https://highermindai.com/about): founder background - ten months contracted inside a property management operation on the sales, CRM and maintenance side, and close to a decade inside the justice system before that. Not a licensed property manager, and says so.
- [Book a call](https://highermindai.com/book/): phone 647-242-5800.

## Key facts
- Operated by a single practitioner, not an agency. The person who sells the work does the work.
- Property side: rental and investor-owner portfolios win through search; condominium corporations win through RFPs, where search is defensive rather than lead-generating.
- The intake desk performs administrative intake only. It answers from the corporation's own documents, triages on the corporation's own criteria, logs, routes to a licensed manager, and stops. Where a jurisdiction licenses management - the CMRAO in Ontario - it never performs a licensed function.
- Guarantees: first page inside 60 days on the agreed primary term, or the monthly pauses until it lands, with a 90-day provision for Toronto, Vancouver and Montreal agreed at kickoff; live in 14 to 21 days or the launch half of the build is not owed.
- No promise of a number of doors. That depends on the firm's fees, close rate and capacity.
- Published rates for the property track are on the pages themselves. Rates are never placed in structured data.
- Serves firms across eight US states and five Canadian regions, one property management firm per market. Published rates are Canadian, in CAD, for Canadian firms; US firms are priced separately in USD and the figure is given on the call.
